summary: La Crosse Forestry Site in Alachua County is listed as a tower at 135 feet elevation by Mapcarta; no readable source gives build, staffing, fate or site status.

evidence.supports: Mapcarta lists the La Crosse Forestry Site as a tower in Alachua County
evidence.quote: La Crosse Forestry Site is a tower in Alachua

evidence.supports: Mapcarta gives LaCrosse Lookout Tower as another name
Mapcarta gives the site an elevation of 135 feet (41 metres)
The town of La Crosse is in Alachua County, about 15 miles north of Gainesville
evidence.quote: is a town in Alachua County, Florida, 15 miles north of Gainesville

evidence.supports: Florida tower list names La Crosse Forestry Site at 29.85833, -82.40778 in Alachua County
Forest Lookouts lists La Crosse under the heading LA CROSSE in Alachua County

corrections.why: The tower list and Mapcarta both use La Crosse Forestry Site. The record copies the capitalisation of the Forest Lookouts heading, LA CROSSE.

sources.title: La Crosse Forestry Site Map - Tower - Alachua, Florida, United States

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No readable source gives build date, design, height, staffing, fate or access, so the story is under the 120-word floor. Mapcarta's elevation of 135 feet (41 metres) matches the tower list's 135, so elevation_m 41 could be filled if the editor accepts Mapcarta, which draws on OpenStreetMap. The Forest Lookouts page is a stub with the heading and county only. The Anyplace America topo page for the site returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Mapcarta's town sentence is a summary of Wikipedia-style text and was not checked against the town's own article.
